policy.followup: same-width measured trials only; finite selective Broyden with R7 J and caps. T1 is extrapolated without inventing an observed W5/W6 seed. Closest by max normalized valley/D/individual peak error, not by BW.
policy.conditional: C1W5 after tuned or closest measured finite W5R. W6R iff W5R tuned; no replacement for failed W6R screen. C1W6 iff W6R tuned and gain at least 0.050 GHz. Numerical missing independent subject to data dependencies, no invented result; strict integrity failure stops all.
